title.tr: Çakıl ve toprak zeminde çaprazlı merdiven
title.en: Cross-braced stairs on gravel and soil

alt.tr: Çakıl serili toprak zeminde çaprazlı korkuluklu ahşap merdiven; arkada beyaz duvar ve beyaz bir araç
alt.en: Timber stairs with a cross-braced railing on soil laid with gravel, with a white wall and a white vehicle behind

caption.tr: Merdivenin ilk basamağı çakıl yatağına oturuyor. İki yanda çaprazlı korkuluk, arkada beyaz bir duvar var.
caption.en: The first step rests on a bed of gravel. Cross-braced railings stand on both sides with a white wall behind.
